name: message-scroller
title: Message scroller
description: A conversation log on @shadcn/react's MessageScroller, as the reference: stays on the newest message, holds the reader's place when scrolled up, keeps position when older messages are prepended; role=log inside a focusable region. Keyline adds: the place also holds when content above changes size (in every engine), arrivals unfold from their top keyline while the reader follows, and a Latest cell that counts what arrived below and jumps a bounded, interruptible distance. The log scrolls inside Keyline's Scroll Area, so its bar is the shared one; the jump reveals it, and pressing it is the reader taking over.
whenToUse: Use it for a conversation log that stays on the newest message and holds the reader's place when they scroll up. For one message use Bubble; for a sender's run use Message.

parts.name: MessageScroller
parts.description: The frame. Give it a height (or put it in a flex column): the viewport scrolls inside.

parts.name: MessageScrollerButton
parts.description: The jump cell: appears on the frame's bottom keyline (end) or top keyline (start) when there is more that way; out of the tab order and hidden while there is nothing to jump to. Toward the end it counts the messages that arrived below the reader ("Latest | 3 new"); pass `children` to name it otherwise.

parts.name: MessageScrollerItem
parts.description: One entry of the log: one sender's run (a Message), a separator, or a notice. `messageId` lets you scroll to it; `scrollAnchor` lands the first view on it.

parts.name: MessageScrollerProvider
parts.description: State for one log. `autoScroll` (default true here) keeps the log on the newest message while the reader is at the end; scrolled up, their place is held. After the reader sends, call `useMessageScroller().scrollToEnd()`.

parts.name: MessageScrollerSeparator
parts.description: A day or "New messages" divider: a seam with its words in the Code voice.

parts.name: MessageScrollerViewport
parts.description: The scrolling region; `aria-label` names it (default "Messages"). `scrollbarVisibility` as on ScrollArea.
